intro.text: Sister Nall, the head ardent of the practice grounds in the Kholin warcamp.

items.text: When Shallan asked to sketch Shardblades and Shardplate on the practice grounds, Nall, impressed with her skill, let her stay, since the royal records' sketches were poor. Adolin, sparring there, pretended to be annoyed but was glad of the chance to keep flirting with her.
